recommendation: DEPRIORITIZED on competitive/precedence grounds (not a scientific no-go and not a claim that the biology is disqualifying)
decision_conditions: Re-evaluate only if (a) a LUAD-specific efficacy/safety readout emerges, or (b) a differentiated profile is demonstrated (biomarker-defined niche and a tumour-to-normal-lung protein-density window). LUAD patients are eligible within nonsquamous-NSCLC B7-H3 ADC trials (NCT07464327 Phase 3; NCT06780085 Phase 2, I-DXd + TROP2 ADC; NCT07824882 Phase 2), so the absence of a LUAD-specific trial is not an absence of LUAD evidence.
key_precedent_in_scope: Zero LUAD-specific B7-H3 trials. Clinical precedence therefore scores 1/5. LUAD is, however, an eligible subset of the nonsquamous-NSCLC trials: NCT07464327 (HS-20093 + adebrelimab, Phase 3, not yet recruiting), NCT06780085 (I-DXd + raludotatug deruxtecan, Phase 2, recruiting) and NCT07824882 (HS-20093 + adebrelimab, Phase 2, not yet recruiting). NSCLC-context efficacy: enoblituzumab + pembrolizumab ORR 33.3% (5/15; IO-naive) and MGC018 ORR 15% (3/20); neither reports LUAD separately.
rationale: ADC is the only B7-H3 modality with a credible clinical path in lung cancer. LUAD is deprioritized because precedence is indirect and competition is intense (TROP2/HER3 ADCs, IO/chemotherapy), not because the biology is disqualifying: the stromal>malignant transcript pattern is shared with SCLC (LUAD malignant-to-fibroblast 0.31, malignant-to-macrophage 0.72; SCLC epithelial-to-fibroblast 0.42), and is treated as a shared antigen-sink caveat. Prior IO/radiation narrow the ILD margin, but that is a payload/population risk.
target_level_risks: Broad low-level normal-tissue B7-H3; shared stromal/myeloid antigen sink (LUAD malignant-to-fibroblast 0.31, malignant-to-macrophage 0.72); soluble B7-H3 decoy; unquantified surface density and internalization; normal-lung bulk RNA level 4 (1,683 TPM) with HPA protein level 2 and low cell-level transcript (13.9 CPM weighted mean).
payload_level_risks: ILD/pneumonitis in a population with prior IO pneumonitis/radiation; myelosuppression; off-tumour payload delivery. These are payload/population liabilities, not CD276 target biology.
normal_lung_qualification: Bulk lung RNA is HPA level 4 (1,683 TPM) but HPA protein is level 2 and the Census normal-lung cell-level transcript is comparatively low (13.9 CPM cell-weighted mean). 'High normal-lung expression' is not supported at protein or cell-resolved transcript level.
stromal_sink_note: Shared across indications: CD276 transcript is higher in fibroblasts than malignant/epithelial cells in both SCLC (0.42) and LUAD (0.31), and LUAD macrophage is also higher (0.72). This is an antigen-sink/surface-antigen caveat for both indications, not a LUAD-specific disqualifier.
cost_timeline_basis: Indicative prior-knowledge range, not database-derived; excludes platform/build-out costs and assumes an existing biologics/ADC capability.
efficacy_caveat: Clinical precedence is feasibility evidence only. No B7-H3 Phase 3 efficacy result is posted in LUAD or SCLC as of 2026-10-20. SCLC: ARTEMIS-008 is completed without posted results; the only posted SCLC-specific result is MGC018 ORR 0/9 (n=9), a small under-enrolled signal, not class-level failure. LUAD: no LUAD-specific trial, but LUAD patients are eligible in nonsquamous-NSCLC trials; a LUAD-specific readout has not been reported.
